description: This file declares the RuntimeManagerHandler class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including its nested RuntimeManagerNotification class. It provides an interface for managing runtime lifecycle events, notifications, and interactions with external components such as IRuntimeManager and IEventHandler.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Handles runtime management operations, notifications, and event handling within the plugin.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Implements the INotification interface to receive runtime lifecycle events and notify the parent RuntimeManagerHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts a runtime application with specified parameters.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills the runtime application identified by appInstanceId.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the runtime application identified by appInstanceId.

methods.name: suspend
methods.description: Suspends the runtime application identified by appInstanceId.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the runtime application identified by appInstanceId.

methods.name: hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates the runtime application identified by appInstanceId.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes the runtime application to a specified state.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics for the specified application.
